newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka to tender for 25,000 T of rice. [CORRECTED 06:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka to tender for 25,000 T of rice. [CORRECTED 06:40 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects amount of tender in headline from 25,000 million)
Sri Lanka will float an international tender for 25,000 tonnes of white raw rice, an official for the state buying arm Cooperative Wholesale Establishment (CWE) said on Wednesday.
The 25,000 tonnes are for delivery in two lots during late December and early January next year, the official said.
He said the tender would be officially announced "in a day or two" with December 6 the final day to present bids.
Government officials earlier said Sri Lanka plans to import up to 400,000 tonnes of rice by the end of this year to meet a crop shortfall caused by drought and rising demand.
The shortfall caused by drought this year was about 300,000 tonnes in addition to the country's average annual rice shortage of around 200,000 tonnes, they said.
